expectations.text: Keeps the exact definitions (half-life: time for plasma concentration to fall by half; therapeutic index: LD50/ED50, larger is safer)
expectations.evidence: States “半衰期（t½）：血药浓度下降到原来一半所需的时间。” and “治疗指数（TI）：药物的半数致死量（LD50）与半数有效量（ED50）的比值，即 TI = LD50 / ED50，通常越大越安全。” Both required definitions are preserved.

expectations.text: Does not force an everyday analogy onto these definitions, or explicitly says why it skips one
expectations.evidence: Explicitly explains: “定义和公式要准确，所以不用类比，直接配例子。” No everyday analogy appears anywhere in the observed turn.

expectations.text: Uses a concrete example (e.g. numbers showing concentration halving, or LD50/ED50 values)
expectations.evidence: Provides both: “血药浓度从 8 mg/L 降到 4 mg/L，用了 6 小时，半衰期就是 6 小时。” and “LD50 为 100 mg/kg，ED50 为 10 mg/kg，治疗指数就是 10，没有单位。”

expectations.text: Ends with a recall question and does not answer it
expectations.evidence: Ends with the recall prompt: “现在遮住上文：请用一句话写出‘半衰期’的定义，并附信心 1–3（1＝不确定，2＝较确定，3＝很确定）。” No answer follows.
